4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const AudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
8:     const osc = AudioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = AudioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.connect(gain);
13:     gain.connect(AudioCtx.destination);
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, AudioCtx.currentTime);
15:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, AudioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, AudioCtx.currentTime + dur);
17:     osc.start();
18:     osc.stop(AudioCtx.currentTime + dur);
19:   }
20:   function playCollisionSound() { playTone(200, 0.2); }
21:   function playPowerUpSound() { playTone(600, 0.15); }
22:   function startBackgroundMusic() {
23:     setInterval(() => playTone(80, 0.3), 2000);
24:   }
25:   let musicStarted = false;
26: 
27:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
28:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
29:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
30:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
31:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);
32: 
33:   // --- player ---
34:   const player = {
35:     x: 50,
36:     y: H / 2 - 15,
37:     w: 30,
38:     h: 30,
39:     dy: 0,
40:     speed: 4,
41:     health: 3,
42:   };
43: 
44:   // --- obstacles & power‑ups ---
45:   const obstacles = [];
46:   const powerUps = [];
47:   let frame = 0;
48:   let score = 0;
49:   let gameOver = false;
50: 
51:   // input handling
52:   const keys = {};
53:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
54:     keys[e.key] = true;
55:     if (!musicStarted) { startBackgroundMusic(); musicStarted = true; }
56:   });
57:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
58: 
59:   // Starfield for background (moving stars)
60:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
61:     x: Math.random() * W,
62:     y: Math.random() * H,
63:     size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
64:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
65:   }));
66: 
67:   function spawnObstacle() {
68:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
69:     obstacles.push({
70:       x: W,
71:       y: Math.random() * (H - radius * 2),
72:       r: radius,
73:       speed: 3 + Math.random() * 2,
74:     });
75:   }
76: 
77:   function spawnPowerUp() {
78:     const size = 15;
79:     powerUps.push({
80:       x: W,
81:       y: Math.random() * (H - size),
82:       size,
83:       angle: 0,
84:       speed: 3,
85:     });
86:   }
87: 
88:   function circleCollide(a, b) {
89:     // treat a as rect, b as circle
90:     const cx = b.x + b.r;
91:     const cy = b.y + b.r;
92:     const nearestX = Math.max(a.x, Math.min(cx, a.x + a.w));
93:     const nearestY = Math.max(a.y, Math.min(cy, a.y + a.h));
94:     const dx = cx - nearestX;
95:     const dy = cy - nearestY;
96:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < b.r * b.r;
97:   }
98: 
99:   function update() {
100:     if (gameOver) return;
101:     // player movement
102:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) player.dy = -player.speed;
103:     else if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) player.dy = player.speed;
104:     else player.dy = 0;
105:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y + player.dy));
106: 
107:     // move stars
108:     stars.forEach(s => {
109:       s.x -= s.speed;
110:       if (s.x < 0) {
111:         s.x = W;
112:         s.y = Math.random() * H;
113:       }
114:     });
115: 
116:     // spawn logic
117:     if (frame % 90 === 0) spawnObstacle();
118:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnPowerUp();
119: 
120:     // update obstacles & power‑ups
121:     obstacles.forEach(o => (o.x -= o.speed));
122:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
123:       p.x -= p.speed;
124:       p.angle += 0.05;
125:     });
126: 
127:     // collision check (player vs obstacles)
128:     obstacles.forEach((o, i) => {
129:       if (circleCollide(player, o)) {
130:         player.health--;
131:         playCollisionSound();
132:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
133:         if (player.health <= 0) gameOver = true;
134:       } else if (o.x + o.r * 2 < 0) {
135:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
136:         score += 10;
137:       }
138:     });
139:     // player vs power‑ups
140:     powerUps.forEach((p, i) => {
141:       if (rectCollide(player, { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.size, h: p.size })) {
142:         player.health = Math.min(3, player.health + 1);
143:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
144:         score += 5;
145:       } else if (p.x + p.size < 0) {
146:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
147:       }
148:     });
149: 
150:     frame++;
151:   }
152: 
153:   function draw() {
154:     // background gradient
155:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
156:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
157:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
158:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
159:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
160:     // stars
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
162:     stars.forEach(s => {
163:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
164:     });
165:     // player ship (triangle neon)
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
167:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
168:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
169:     ctx.beginPath();
170:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h / 2);
171:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y);
172:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
173:     ctx.closePath();
174:     ctx.fill();
175:     ctx.stroke();
176:     // obstacles (glowing circles)
177:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
178:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
179:         o.x + o.r,
180:         o.y + o.r,
181:         o.r * 0.2,
182:         o.x + o.r,
183:         o.y + o.r,
184:         o.r
185:       );
186:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,85,85,0.8)');
187:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,0,0)');
188:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
189:       ctx.beginPath();
190:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.r, o.y + o.r, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
191:       ctx.fill();
192:     });
193:     // power‑ups (rotating squares with glow)
194:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
195:       ctx.save();
196:       ctx.translate(p.x + p.size / 2, p.y + p.size / 2);
197:       ctx.rotate(p.angle);
198:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(85,255,85,0.7)';
199:       ctx.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
200:       ctx.restore();
201:     });
202:     // UI
203:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
204:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
205:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
206:     ctx.fillText('Health: ' + player.health, 10, 40);
207:     if (gameOver) {
208:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
209:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
210:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
211:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
212:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
213:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
214:     }
215:   }
216: 
217:   function loop() {
218:     update();
219:     draw();
220:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221:   }

225: })();
